rules: ticket = "vt-ticket/2." + b64url(payload JSON, keys j,w,c,g,t,r,a,k,p,to,value,f,q,e,n in that order, no whitespace) + "." + b64url(HMAC-SHA256(key, "vt-ticket/2." + b64url(payload))); b64url = RFC 4648 §5, no padding; field formats: src/contracts/http.ts
valid while now < e; e = issuedAt + ttlMs; n = 16 lowercase hex; a v1 ticket ("vt-ticket/1.", or a v1 payload under the v2 prefix) is refused: relay.send-ticket

verifyTicket (S1) refuses format and MAC (relay.send-ticket) and expiry (relay.ticket-expired); the relay gate adds w = its network (relay.ticket-network), c = the route chain (relay.ticket-chain), r = sha256(raw bytes) (relay.ticket-raw), the job-send lock (release.mainnet-locked), then the decode verification (relay.decode-mismatch: src/contracts/http.ts)
raw bytes: ETH = params[0] hex decoded; SOL = params[0] base64 decoded; every valid raw is a genuine signed tx by `signers`
each negative and each decode vector has exactly one defect; context = the relay's network, the route chain and the raw param

valid.name: local eth job to the null address; f = gas × maxFee exactly
testnet sol job: legacy message, CU limit + price + one Memo v2; f = the exact fee
mainnet eth job (the relay refuses it while mainnet job sends are locked: release.mainnet-locked)
local eth claw-back: value to the destination, no data
testnet sol claw-back: one System transfer, no compute budget (price 0: the declared limit is the default, not in the tx); f = 5000
local eth job to the sender itself (eth.calldata.self); f above the worst case
local sol job: CU limit only (passive: no price, fee 5000), as vt's builder makes it
testnet sol claw-back with a priority fee (limit 450, price 27778 → ⌈12.5001⌉ = 13)
testnet eth job with tip = maxFee
testnet sol job at the prompt rung (limit 33000, price ⌈12500 × 10⁶ / 33000⌉ = 378788); f = the exact fee
